title: High-Performance Graphene-Modified Sensing Chip for SARS-CoV-2 Detection
protocol: Clean the DIDC chip surface with piranha solution (H2SO4:H2O2 in a 3:1 ratio).
Place the cleaned chip on the hot plate at 80 °C for 15 min.
Rinse the sensor surface with distilled water drop by drop using a pipette.
Rinse the surface with four to five drops of ethyl alcohol.
Dry the sensor surface at room temperature to obtain a hydrophilic sensor surface.
Cover the clean sensor chip electrode pads with polyimide tape.
Place the chip on the center of the spin-coating machine in the horizontal position.
Add 4 µL of an aqueous solution of commercially available single-layer graphene oxide (GO) onto the chip surface.
Close the spin-coating chamber and run for 2 min at 1,300 rpm.
Keep the chip on the hot plate horizontally for 40 min at 80 °C for annealing.
Perform cross-linking of EDC and NHS with the thin-film GO chip.
Add 4 µL each of 0.4 M EDC and 0.1 M NHS to the thin-film GO chip.
Dissolve commercially available anti-SARS-CoV-2 Abs using dilution buffer (0.01 M PBS containing 0.1% BSA and 0.86% NaCl).
Add 1 mL of diluted PBS to 1 µg of purified antibody.
Drop cast 4 µL of the antibody solution onto the cross-linked activated GO-DIDC chip.
Leave the chip in the closed chamber for 2 h at room temperature to bind the Abs onto functionalized chip surface.
Drop-cast 4 µL of bovine serum albumin (BSA) onto the chip to block non-specific sites of the immuno-capacitive sensing chip.
Place the chip horizontally in the closed chamber for 20 min at room temperature.
Wash the immuno-capacitive sensing chip with DI water.
Dry the chip at room temperature.
Prepare different concentrations of virus spike antigen from 1.0 mg to 1.0 fg for detection.
